verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust UI framework with hydrated islands, so the ability to manipulate the DOM directly is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents only compiler-emitted island JavaScript (signals, event handlers, a small runtime) and server-rendered SVG charts. None of it shows refs, raw DOM access, or a way to mount third-party browser libraries such as charting tools. The server-side SVG charts are an adjacent feature, not direct DOM integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can directly manipulate the DOM to integrate existing browser libraries like charting or visualization tools
